title: Decompose ChatServices into bounded modules
description:
Problem: ChatServices.cs combines contracts, provider implementations, orchestration, tool loops, and write proposal handling in one very large file.

Desired outcome: reduce complexity and review blast radius by splitting chat concerns into clear modules while preserving behavior.

Scope:
- In scope: extract contracts/models, provider adapters, orchestration/tool loop, and write-approval pipeline into focused files/services.
- Out of scope: net-new chat features or provider capability changes.

Dependencies:
- Characterization tests for chat critical flows.
- Coordination with TSK-0044 for test fixture decomposition.

Acceptance criteria:
- ChatServices hotspot is materially reduced in size and concern count.
- Existing chat API/UI behavior remains unchanged.
- New structure has clear ownership boundaries and test coverage continuity.

Validation:
- Run focused chat tests and impacted API contract tests.
- Verify chat send/stream/tool loop/write proposal paths remain green.

Rollback:
- Revert extraction slices individually if regressions surface.

comments.body: Audit-family validation note: after re-checking Audit #5 and the paired general vector report on 2026-05-29, the broad maintainability complaint about `ChatServices.cs` still stands even though most of the earlier security findings were already closed under `TSK-0205`. `TSK-0212` now owns the narrower live parse/buffer fallback defects, while `TSK-0042` remains the larger readability/decomposition owner.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Audit #9 (2026-06-11, audits/hyperagent-audit-9-architecture-deepening-20260611) sharpens this with a specific locality failure to fix FIRST, before or with the file split: the tool loop exists TWICE inside MemoryChatAgent - SendAsync delegates to CompleteWithToolCallsAsync (line 2081) while StreamAsync carries its own inline loop (~1887-2080); model resolution is also duplicated (lines 1838 vs 3273). Every loop bug must be fixed twice. Recommended order: (1) extract ONE tool-call loop module both entry points drive (streaming emits events, non-streaming collects), unit-tested via the existing FakeChatProvider pattern; (2) then split the file along type boundaries (protocol records / OllamaChatProvider / GitHubCopilotChatProvider / MemoryChatAgent). Provider-name special-casing is tracked separately as TSK-0283 - coordinate but don't merge scopes. Graded Strong in the audit.
